author: Salem Techsperts
description: If GeForce Now becomes the ONLY option to play games, I'm switching careers. But for 6 years it's proven to be a great option for gaming on hardware that wouldn't otherwise be able to. Ad or not, the facts stand. Link is in my bio if you want to try it out on your potato.
title: Everyone Deserves to Game No Matter The Hardware #shorts #tech #technology #pc #geforcenow
